findings.claim: A side effect of the fixture regeneration (edu-007): fixtures/signups.json now has 4 sign-ups, with one in 'general', two in 'testing' and one in 'data'. README line 85's paging example '?limit=2&offset=1 skips the first sign-up and returns the next two' cannot be shown on the shipped data in the optional uvicorn run (line 87, 'try the routes'). /sessions/general/signups?limit=2&offset=1 returns [] and /sessions/testing/signups?limit=2&offset=1 returns one sign-up. The checks use their own SIGNUPS, so nothing fails; but a novice who tries the README's own example in /docs sees a result that seems to contradict it.
findings.recommendation: Name the session the example comes from and use values the fixture can show, e.g. '/sessions/testing/signups?limit=1&offset=1 skips Ben Okafor and returns Eli Novak'. Or say that the example describes the checks' data, not the snapshot.
